high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the user "zoyasharmakumar." The post shows a person standing outdoors in front of a stone railing with a lush green background filled with trees and bushes adorned with red flowers. The person is wearing a traditional Indian outfit consisting of a red blouse paired with a black saree that has intricate designs and embellishments. The saree is draped elegantly over one shoulder, and the person's left hand rests on the railing while their right hand is placed on their hip. They have long, dark hair that falls loosely around their shoulders.
